# MCP tool catalog (generated)

Every tool `vtai_agent.mcp_server.build_server()` exposes on one MCP

## `auto_mode`

Autonomous loop: give a coding CLI the goal, then review its reply against the goal and iterate with corrective prompts until the answer matches the goal or max_iterations is reached.

| input | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `goal` | `str` | yes | — | The full goal or question to satisfy. |
| `working_dir` | `str` | no | '.' | Project directory the CLI runs in (must be writable). |
| `cli` | `str` | no | 'opencode' | Which coding agent to drive: opencode \| claude \| pi |
| `max_iterations` | `int` | no | 3 | (no description supplied) |
| `timeout` | `float` | no | 600.0 | (no description supplied) |
| `dry_run` | `bool | None` | no | None (config default applies) | Report the plan only; do not run the CLI. |

## `backup_sync`

Incremental directory backup/sync via rsync. Reports the transfer plan (files/bytes, what changes) and can verify with a second checksum pass. Deletion of extraneous destination files is opt-in and never happens in a dry run.

| input | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | `str` | yes | — | Directory to back up. |
| `destination` | `str` | yes | — | Backup destination directory (must be writable). |
| `dry_run` | `bool | None` | no | None (config default applies) | Preview the transfer plan only. |
| `delete_extraneous` | `bool` | no | False | Delete files in destination not present in source. DANGEROUS — ignored unless the run is in EXECUTE mode. |
| `compress` | `bool` | no | True | Use rsync -z for network transfers. |
| `verify` | `bool` | no | True | Re-run a checksum comparison after transfer. |

## `delegate_coding`

Delegate a coding task to opencode, claude, or pi in headless mode. Snapshots the repo first, captures the resulting diff, optionally verifies, and rolls back automatically if verification fails.

| input | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cli` | `str` | yes | — | Which coding agent to delegate to: opencode \| claude \| pi |
| `prompt` | `str` | yes | — | The coding task, e.g. 'Fix the off-by-one in parser.py'. |
| `working_dir` | `str` | yes | — | Project directory to run in (must be a git repo). |
| `dry_run` | `bool | None` | no | None (config default applies) | Snapshot and show the plan; do not run the delegate. |
| `verify_command` | `str | None` | no | None (config default applies) | Allowlisted command that must pass after the edit (e.g. 'pytest'). Failure triggers rollback. Relative path args are checked against the repo dir. |
| `auto_rollback` | `bool` | no | True | Restore the git snapshot if verification fails. |
| `require_approval` | `bool` | no | True | After the delegate runs and verification passes, show the diff and wait for explicit human approval before keeping the changes. Non-interactive sessions roll back and report 'needs_approval' instead. Defaults to True — an unattended run cannot silently keep its changes; pass false only when a human has already reviewed the task. |
| `timeout` | `float` | no | 600.0 | Seconds before the delegate is killed. |
| `skip_permissions` | `bool` | no | False | Allow --dangerously-skip-permissions so the CLI runs fully unattended. Only use on trusted, isolated projects. |

## `disk_audit`

Read-only scan for reclaimable space: largest and oldest files, plus sizes of common cache directories. Deletes nothing — use it to decide what to clean, then clean with a guarded tool.

| input | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | `str` | no | '/' | Root to scan. |
| `min_size_mb` | `int` | no | 100 | Only report files at least this large. |
| `older_than_days` | `int` | no | 30 | Only report files older than this. |
| `limit` | `int` | no | 25 | Max files to report. |
| `include_caches` | `bool` | no | True | Also measure known cache directories. |

## `inspect_application`

Analyze an application with REA (static reverse engineering) under full guardrails: deny-glob check, quarantine copy, minimal child environment, evidence digest in the audit trail, optional judge pass against the goal. The REA capability must be enabled in config.

| input | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `goal` | `str` | yes | — | What you want to learn, e.g. 'explain how the CSV export builds its header row'. |
| `target` | `str` | yes | — | Path to the app to analyze (directory, ASAR, or binary). It is copied into quarantine first; the original is never touched. |
| `judge` | `bool` | no | True | Review REA's evidence against the goal with the configured model before reporting success (same verify-then-trust policy as auto_mode). |
| `keep_copy` | `bool | None` | no | None (config default applies) | Keep the quarantine copy after the run (defaults to config capabilities.rea.keep_copy). |
| `timeout` | `float | None` | no | None (config default applies) | Seconds before REA is killed (defaults to config capabilities.rea.timeout). |
| `dry_run` | `bool | None` | no | None (config default applies) | Report the planned copy dir and argv without running REA. Defaults to config dry_run_default. |

## `organize_files`

Content-aware cleanup of a directory: sorts files into Documents/Images/Videos/Audio/Archives/Installers/Code/Data/Fonts/Models, auto-renames collisions. Destination stays inside the directory, within writable_roots.

| input | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `directory` | `str` | no | '~/Downloads' | Directory to tidy up. |
| `dry_run` | `bool | None` | no | None (config default applies) | Plan only, move nothing. Defaults to guardrails.dry_run_default. |
| `recursive` | `bool` | no | False | Descend into subdirectories. |
| `confirm_mime` | `bool` | no | True | Use `file` mime type to resolve unknown extensions. |

## `run_shell`

Run an allowlisted shell command. Denied binaries, protected or out-of-sandbox path arguments, and dangerous flags raise instead of executing. Set dry_run=true to preview the plan only.

| input | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `command` | `str` | yes | — | Shell command. The binary must be a bare allowlisted name with a sandbox policy; every path argument is deny/writable-checked. |
| `dry_run` | `bool | None` | no | None (config default applies) | Preview without executing. Defaults to config guardrails.dry_run_default. |
| `timeout` | `float` | no | 30.0 | (no description supplied) |

## `system_info`

Read-only snapshot of this machine: CPU, memory, disk, load, and AMD GPU state. Safe to call any time; used to ground decisions before acting.

| input | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `include_gpu` | `bool` | no | True | Probe AMD/NPU via rocm-smi when available |

## `transcode_media`

Batch transcode videos with AMD GPU hardware acceleration (VAAPI). Outputs go to a 'transcoded' subfolder and originals are never modified. Automatically skips its own output directory to avoid re-encoding loops.

| input | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `directory` | `str` | yes | — | Directory containing videos to transcode (searched recursively). |
| `dry_run` | `bool | None` | no | None (config default applies) | Report what would be transcoded; encode nothing. |
| `codec` | `str | None` | no | None (config default applies) | Encoder: h264_vaapi \| hevc_vaapi \| av1_vaapi \| libx264 (defaults to config). |
| `crf` | `int | None` | no | None (config default applies) | Quality for software codecs (lower = better). |
| `recursive` | `bool` | no | True | Descend into subdirectories. |
| `overwrite` | `bool` | no | False | Re-encode even if an output already exists. |
